params.body:
Costume U1, U2 and U7 to U10 come in two finishes (Mat and Glanzend), but the order form never asked which one. `Catalog::frameOptions()` already resolved `finishes`; nothing in the order flow read it, so an order for a U1 reached the workshop without a finish.

What changes:

- The order popup and the full configurator show an **Afwerking** select, required, when the frame offers more than one finish. A frame in a single finish (U3 to U6, every Couture frame) asks nothing, as before.
- `addToCart` stores `finish` on the line and refuses a line whose finish is missing or not one of the frame's, so a stale or bypassed form cannot slip through.
- Editing a cart line pre-selects the stored finish.
- The finish shows on the line in the cart, the confirmation page, the order history and both order mails.
- Labels "Afwerking" and "Kies een afwerking" in EN, FR and DE.

The value is the finish name in the dealer's language, as the colour already is.

Content note, not code: in the Studio, U11 and U12 carry only Mat. If they are also sold in Glanzend, adding it to their Afwerkingen is enough; the form follows.

Tests: `tests/Feature/FinishChoiceTest.php` covers the select appearing only when there is a choice, the line keeping the finish into the cart, refusal of a missing or unknown finish, and editing a line.

Closes #80

Source: Portal mail:17.
params.title: Ask for the finish on frames that come in more than one
